Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 01-Jan-2025 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
 FIFTH SEMESTER B.TECH. (COMPUTER SCIENCE & ENGINEERING) EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2024 / JANUARY  
  2025  
  SUBJECT: CSE 3123/CSE_3123 - OPERATING SYSTEMS  
  OPERATING SYSTEMS [CSE 3123]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                          Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)                Explain the six major categories of system calls in an operating system.                                   (3)  
1B)                Relate how the degree of multi-programming is affected by long-term and medium-term scheduler.             (3)  
1C)                Utilize the following page reference string:                                                               (4)  
  1, 2, 3, 4, 2, 1, 5, 6, 2, 1, 2, 3, 7, 6, 3, 2, 1, 2, 3, 6.  
  
  Identify the number of page faults would occur for the following replacement algorithms, assuming  
  four frames.  
  _ FIFO replacement  
  _ Optimal replacement  
2A)                Consider the following system.                                                                             (4)  
  
  
  The above system schedules processes using priority preemption with aging. Aging is a concept  
  where priority (integer value) of a process is reduced by 1 after a certain time waiting in the ready  
  queue. In the above system, the lower integer value represents higher priority. The aging time for  
  the system is 3 ms.  
  
  Make use of Gantt chart,  
  i) to schedule the processes as per the above-mentioned requirements.  
  ii) to calculate turnaround time and waiting time for each process.  
2B)                Consider the following snapshot of a system.                                                               (3)  
  
  
  Utilize Banker's algorithm to find: (i) the content of the matrix Need. (ii) the smallest value of x for  
  which the system in a safe state.  
2C)                Develop a process Pi that can implement mutual exclusion with test_and_set() instruction. Identify         (3)  
  Page 1 of 2

how the developed process supports mutual exclusion.  
3A)   i) Describe how swap space affects the performance of the operating system and where they             (5)  
  reside. Illustrate it with a UNIX system example.  
  ii) Assume that a disk drive has cylinders numbered 0 to 4999. Cylinder 143 is currently serving by  
  drive, and the cylinder 125 was a previous request. The 86, 1470, 913, 1774, 948, 1509, 1022,  
  1750, 130 are pending requests. What will be the time taken to service each request using SSTF  
  algorithm.  
  (3+2 = 5 marks)  
3B)   i) What are the different Accessing Methods of a File?                                                (5)  
  ii) Explain what is symbolic link and list at least two of its drawbacks.  
  (3+2 = 5 marks)  
4A)   Assuming a page size of 2K and a 32-bit machine, how many bits are used for the page number,          (4)  
  and how many are used for the offset within the page? Give three main reasons why page sizes  
  are usually powers of two.  
4B)   How should the OS proceed if the processor wants to execute page 7, assuming that pages 1 to 5        (4)  
  of the active process are in main memory and pages 6 to 10 of the same process are stored in  
  secondary memory? Explain with the block diagram.  
4C)   Differentiate between logical address space and physical address space with an example.               (2)  
5A)   A key design decision in OS memory management is the choice between paging and            (4)  
  segmentation. Compare and contrast these two approaches to memory management, making sure  
  to identify the strengths and weaknesses of each.  
5B)   Explain locality model used to prevent thrashing.                                                     (3)  
5C)   Discuss the strengths and weaknesses of implementing an access matrix using access lists that         (3)  
  are associated with objects.
